cs.t: My Das Keyboard 3. I bought it in 2008. Still using it. So glad quality mechanical keyboards made a comeback. A four-input KVM switch. Lets me switch between my main machine, my work computer, and a couple of other things easily. The VIC-20 my parents bought me when I was 5. No games, just BASIC on that rinky-dink thing. But it made me a programmer.
cs.th: Ask HN: Any piece of hardware that was more of game changer than you expected?
